entries.title: The Last Haven
entries.definitive_edition: The Last Haven on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Last Haven is a Windows post-nuclear settlement survival and base-building strategy game from Thunder Devs. The full release date is February 17, 2023, after a 2020 Early Access launch, and no console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. Windows PC is therefore the complete route and best archive capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release. Use the latest patch before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched Steam build.
